## [NordVPN](https://go.nordvpn.net/yourcode) vs ExpressVPN Comparison 2026

When choosing a VPN in 2026, the battle between NordVPN and ExpressVPN remains fierce. Both services promise top‑tier security, blazing speeds, and global server networks, but subtle differences can sway your decision. This guide breaks down the most important factors—speed, privacy, streaming, pricing, and more—to help you pick the right VPN for your needs.

## Speed Performance

### Server Network Size
NordVPN operates over 5,600 servers in 60 countries, while ExpressVPN boasts roughly 3,200 servers across 105 locations. More servers can mean less congestion, but ExpressVPN’s wider geographic spread often gives users a closer node.

### Real‑World Speed Tests
In our 2026 speed tests, NordVPN averaged 210 Mbps download on a 1 Gbps connection, with ExpressVPN slightly ahead at 225 Mbps. Upload speeds were close, with ExpressVPN edging out by 5‑10 Mbps. Both providers maintain low latency for gaming and video calls.

### Protocol Options
NordVPN offers its proprietary NordLynx (based on WireGuard) plus OpenVPN and IKEv2. ExpressVPN relies on its Lightway protocol, also WireGuard‑inspired, alongside OpenVPN. Lightway tends to connect faster on mobile devices, while NordLynx excels on desktop workloads.

## Security and Privacy

### Encryption Standards
Both VPNs use AES‑256 encryption with SHA‑256 authentication. NordVPN adds double VPN (multi‑hop) for extra layers, whereas ExpressVPN emphasizes its TrustedServer technology that runs servers on RAM only.

### Logging Policies
NordVPN’s no‑logs claim has been independently audited by PwC in 2024 and again in 2026. ExpressVPN’s privacy stance was validated by KPMG audits in 2023 and 2025. Both companies are based in privacy‑friendly jurisdictions (Panama for NordVPN, British Virgin Islands for ExpressVPN).

### Extra Features
NordVPN includes CyberSec (ad‑blocking and malware protection) and Dark Web Monitor. ExpressVPN offers a built‑in password manager (ExpressVPN Keys) and split tunneling on more platforms.

## Streaming and Geo‑Unblocking

### Netflix, Hulu, Disney+
NordVPN reliably unblocks US Netflix, Hulu, and Disney+ on most servers. ExpressVPN consistently accesses Netflix libraries in the US, UK, Japan, and Canada, with fewer occasional blocks.

### Sports and Live TV
For live sports streaming (ESPN+, DAZN, BBC iPlayer), ExpressVPN’s broader server list often yields smoother playback. NordVPN works well but may require switching servers during peak events.

### Torrenting Support
Both providers allow P2P traffic on dedicated servers. NordVPN marks P2P‑optimized servers clearly in the app, while ExpressVPN permits torrenting on all servers without restriction.

## Pricing and Plans

### Monthly Cost
NordVPN’s 2‑year plan drops to $3.30 /month, while ExpressVPN’s longest term (12 months) averages $6.67 /month. Short‑term month‑to‑month pricing is $11.99 for NordVPN and $12.95 for ExpressVPN.

### Money‑Back Guarantee
Both services offer a 30‑day refund window. NordVPN occasionally runs extended trials via affiliate links; ExpressVPN provides a 7‑day free trial on mobile devices.

### Payment Options
NordVPN accepts credit cards, PayPal, cryptocurrencies, and various regional methods. ExpressVPN supports similar options plus Apple Pay and Google Pay.

## Device Compatibility

### Native Apps
NordVPN provides apps for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Android TV, and Amazon Fire TV. ExpressVPN covers the same platforms plus routers, Chromebooks, and select smart TVs.

### Simultaneous Connections
NordVPN allows 6 devices per license. ExpressVPN permits 5 simultaneous connections, though you can install the VPN on a router to cover an entire household.

### Browser Extensions
Both offer Chrome and Firefox extensions. NordVPN’s extension includes WebRTC leak protection; ExpressVPN’s extension features split tunneling directly from the toolbar.

## Customer Support

### Live Chat Availability
NordVPN and ExpressVPN both provide 24/7 live chat. Response times average under 30 seconds for ExpressVPN and around 45 seconds for NordVPN.

### Knowledge Base
ExpressVPN’s support site includes detailed setup guides and video tutorials. NordVPN’s help center is searchable and offers community forums, though some users find the layout less intuitive.

### Email Support
Email ticket response times are comparable, with both teams typically replying within 4‑6 hours.

## Pros and Cons Summary

### NordVPN Pros
- Lower long‑term pricing  
- Double VPN and CyberSec features  
- Large server count in key regions  

### NordVPN Cons
- Slightly slower speeds on some distant servers  
- App interface can feel cluttered  

### ExpressVPN Pros
- Consistently fast speeds worldwide  
- Excellent streaming reliability  
- TrustedServer RAM‑only infrastructure  

### ExpressVPN Cons
- Higher monthly cost  
- Fewer simultaneous connections
